title: xDrip followers sync feature dead after Google FCM API removed on 22.07.2024
symptom: After Google removed the old FCM API, communication between xDrip master and followers is broken using the default sync; followers do not receive data.
cause: Google deprecated and removed the old FCM (Firebase Cloud Messaging) API on 2024-07-22, which xDrip's default master/follower sync relied on.
fix: Update to release 2024.09.15b or any later version and enable the setting 'Use xDrip Cloud' on the xDrip Sync Settings page on both the master and all followers.
evidence_quote:
Update to the release of 2024.09.15b or any after that.

Make sure to enable the setting `Use xDrip Cloud` on the xDrip Sync Settings page on the master and followers.
